_comment: Controlled vocabulary for the firm_type column on targets. This is not cosmetic: firm_type decides contact targeting, because human_capital_first promotes Human Capital titles above campus-specific ones at firms where Human Capital sits closer to the budget. A typo used to degrade that routing silently. Intake now normalizes against this list. Labels are seeded from the values already live in data/targets.csv, so no existing row needs remapping. An unrecognized value is still accepted and stored verbatim, flagged as uncategorized, so sourcing is never blocked by a missing category.

_entry_shape.label: canonical stored value; must match data/targets.csv firm_type exactly
_entry_shape.aliases: lowercased spellings normalized to label on intake
_entry_shape.human_capital_first: promote Human Capital above campus titles in contacts/discover.py
